claim: Retrieval-augmented generation eliminates 100% of hallucinations across all neural network architectures.
chunk_text: In our benchmarks across open-domain QA tasks, RAG reduced hallucination rates from 28% to under 6%, though it did not eliminate errors entirely.

claim: RAG reduces factual error rates in medical QA benchmarks.
chunk_text: Evaluating RAG on medical QA datasets demonstrated a statistically significant reduction in factual error rates compared to ungrounded baselines.
